title: kate-ui: paint the selection after the line background
summary: The selection quad is painted after the line background and before the glyphs. The current-line quad stays first. The caret stays last. The test builds only on macOS. macos-15 runs it.

lane.reason: paint.rs compiles only on macOS. The regression test is cfg target_os macos. The macos-15 job runs it. A Linux agent cannot compile this file.

definitions.definition:
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub(crate) enum LinePaintStep {
    CurrentLine,
    TextBackground,
    Selection,
    Text,
    Caret,
}

pub(crate) fn line_paint_steps() -> &'static [LinePaintStep]

data_contracts.schema_diff_summary: paint.rs is already cfg(target_os = macos). The test function also has cfg(target_os = macos). Linux CI does not compile this file. The macos-15 job runs the test. That job is the evidence. line_paint_steps returns CurrentLine, TextBackground, Selection, Text, then Caret. draw_editor matches that slice in order. CurrentLine paints the current-line quad only on the caret line. TextBackground is paint_background. Selection is paint_line_selections. Text is line.paint. Caret is paint_line_carets. The selection quad uses the existing marked color. Leave keys.rs, layout.rs, and the theme files unchanged. This packet does not enable the gpui-tests feature. Leave session.rs, lib.rs, and files.rs in kate-ui unchanged. PKT-0051 owns those files. Leave bar.rs unchanged. PKT-0067 owns that file. Branch from the current tip of main. base_sha records that tip at planning time. If main has moved, use the new tip.

regression_tests.name: paint::tests::selection_is_painted_after_the_line_background
regression_tests.asserts: This test fails on main because line_paint_steps does not exist. The test has cfg(target_os = macos). The slice is CurrentLine, then TextBackground, then Selection, then Text, then Caret. Selection comes after TextBackground. Selection comes before Text.
